title: Reading more than you remember
lede: What should live in the model's weights, and what should it look up?
body: A model's knowledge is frozen at training time, cannot cite a source, and goes stale. In 2020 Facebook AI's RAG paired a generator with a retriever: embed the question, find relevant passages, and answer with them in view. That pattern, retrieval-augmented generation, now sits behind most production systems that answer questions about private or current information.

The alternative is to read everything at once. Context windows grew from about 2,000 tokens to 100,000 in 2023 and a million in 2024. But in 2023 researchers found models use the middle of a long context poorly, which is one reason good retrieval never went away.
transition: Text was never going to be the only input.
